The question asks for the wife of the founder of the city where the 2023 Tour De France started. Both the Predicted Answer and the Ground Truth Answer attempt to provide this information. The Predicted Answer states that the 2023 Tour de France started in Bilbao, founded by Diego López V de Haro, whose wife was María Díaz de Haro. The Ground Truth Answer claims that the wife was Violant of Castile. The name "Violant of Castile" does not appear anywhere in the Predicted Answer. Furthermore, the Predicted Answer explicitly names a different wife (María Díaz de Haro), indicating a substantive difference.
